title: Signed but Not Safe: Requirement Integrity in Multi-Agent LLM Handoffs
abstract: arXiv:2611.07483v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Enterprise AI agents increasingly split a user's request across subagents and merge their results, and each handoff can summarize away, alter or ignore a requirement. We report a preregistered study with synthetic, exactly scorable tasks comparing free-text, structured JSON and signed requirement-manifest handoffs: the orchestrator extracts each requirement as a verbatim quote plus a checkable predicate, code signs the manifest with HMAC-SHA256, and deterministic code verifies the merger's decision. With Qwen3-8B (1,440 trajectories, five threats), signed manifests cut unsafe commits under attack from 69.4% to 9.0% (60.4 pp, 95% CI [51.4, 69.4]) with no net loss of conformant commits relative to structured handoffs. Signing is what defeats in-transit tampering: an unsigned manifest committed violations in 79% of mutated runs, the signed one in none. On identical trajectories the deterministic verifier caught 78.7% of violating decision

translated_title: 签名但并非安全：多智能体LLM交接中的需求完整性
translated_abstract: 企业级AI智能体越来越多地将用户的请求拆分给多个子智能体并合并其结果，而每一次交接都可能概括掉、篡改或忽略某项需求。我们报告了一项预注册研究，使用合成的、可精确评分的任务，比较了自由文本、结构化JSON和带签名的需求清单三种交接方式：编排器将每项需求提取为逐字引用加上可核查的谓词，代码使用HMAC-SHA256对清单进行签名，并由确定性代码验证合并器的决策。使用Qwen3-8B（1,440条轨迹，五种威胁），带签名的清单将攻击下的不安全提交从69.4%降至9.0%（降低60.4个百分点，95%置信区间[51.4, 69.4]），且与结构化交接相比，合规提交没有净损失。签名正是击败传输中篡改的关键：未签名的清单在79%的篡改运行中提交了违规内容，而签名的清单则一次也没有。在相同的轨迹上，确定性验证器捕获了78.7%的违规决策。
tldr: 该论文提出一种带HMAC-SHA256签名的需求清单交接机制，配合确定性代码验证，将多智能体LLM系统在攻击下的不安全提交从69.4%降至9.0%，且不损失合规提交。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a signed requirement-manifest handoff mechanism using HMAC-SHA256 signing with deterministic code verification, cutting unsafe commits under attack in multi-agent LLM systems from 69.4% to 9.0% with no net loss of conformant commits.
